I posted a reply in your DM (DGBRAIN0002) explaining why I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest.

- My world tools have no scheduler, and the calendar tool has no recurrence option, so I can't create a repeating job.
- I can build a digest on request: I'll read #coastal-team (you're a member) and DM you what's new since your last check.
- If you'd like a daily reminder to ask, I can create a one-off 09:00 calendar event, but it won't repeat.
